editorial: Lee Cronin revitalizes the mummy genre with a gripping blend of psychological horror and genuine supernatural dread. The premise—a seemingly joyful reunion turning into a nightmarish ordeal—is immediately unsettling, and the film successfully ramps up the tension as the truth about the disappearance unfolds. This is a fresh, genuinely terrifying take on the classic monster trope that will keep viewers on the edge of their seats.
